notes.title: State of Development and Planned Release
notes.notes:
[h1]Mandatory short introduction[/h1]

Hello, and thank you for being here. 
I am [b]Aaron "Koss" Parpaiola[/b], the solo developer behind '[i][b]TOWST: The One Who Sees Things[/b][/i]', writing you from Europe.

This is my first game and I have no particular skills in game making or game design, or anything tangentially related to it. 

The game want to be a love letter to the puzzle and adventure games I love the most, while also adding other themes I find fascinating or make me who I am. 


I also want to clear any doubt that, despite being a humorous play on words inspired by '[i]The Looker[/i]' (By [i]Bradley Lovell[/i]) '[i]The One Who Sees Things[/i]' is somehow taking itself seriously, at least enough to attempt to evoke a lot of feelings and emotions (positive ones, I hope).

This, thankfully, does not exclude humor from being present.
A tragicomedy, if you will.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45256776/e9fe1b263b3b77a5f2943ce2b635889ae2e1fedb.png[/img]

[h1]So what's the state of development?[/h1]

Between highs and lows (mostly the latter) development proceeds, albeit slowly, and the plan remain for a [b]2025 release[/b].

It will be on Steam for Windows and, thanks to Valve and Proton, for the steamdeck and Linux too.
It will be in English, and I hope I can find solutions to add other languages, but I have no news regarding that for now.

A lot of recent focus have been introspective: have my goals changed? Have I derailed from what I had set out to do?
I did not like some of the answers, but I acknowledged them, cleared my mind and gathered strength.

There are a lot of [i]things[/i] I cannot show- this being a puzzle game where "the least you know the better". I am trying to discover the balance between sharing, not too much, keeping interest, and making the actual game.

Soon I hope to have a new playtest version available which will focus on the story/narration.
I plan (so many plans) to post a devlog update here on steam sometime later related to this very topic and how I decided to approach it after some trial and error, and how I made it work both in-story and in-gameplay (at least I hope so).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45256776/6a238a54b28cffa882838232f8bae9e7da1fe113.png[/img]

Until then, you can find me slightly more active on Bluesky @theonewhoponder, and/or you can join the game's official discord (can click the discord icon at the bottom).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45256776/15f9e7253c4fba8c53926e25173748b631a11d38.png[/img]hank you for reading, I wish you all a nice day.

-Aaron
